parsed.strategy: Own only names with a hand-verified dated event inside Oct 12-Nov 13, 2026: semicap earnings (ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, TER Oct 27), biotech prints and one PDUFA (MRK Oct 10, ARGX Oct 22, NVO Nov 4), defense reports (Saab Oct 23, Kongsberg Oct 29, Rheinmetall and Hensoldt Nov 5), Hon Hai Tech Day Oct 30, Cameco Nov 3, Aristocrat Nov 12, Evolution Oct 23. Dates are spread so no single day decides the book. I would be wrong if a macro shock or a beat-but-sell-the-news reaction hits several prints at once, or if any estimated date slips outside the window.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 using only dated-catalyst names.

strategy.brief: Catalyst calendar: only names with a DATED catalyst in the CATALYSTS evidence (earnings, PDUFA, investor day) inside the horizon. Diversify across dates so no single day decides the book. Competition rules: long only, global, <= 10% per name, >= 8 names, NO ETFs, cash <= 2%, graded as relative P&L vs the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13.
